name: Madison's Flower
source:
This game is a prologue of [url=https://vndb.org/v38826]Time's Novel[/url].

Madison has a crush on the rich popular guy from her school. She get's invited to his party and plans on confessing her feelings towards him there.

[From [url=https://intstories.itch.io/madisons-flower]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作是[url=https://vndb.org/v38826]《Time's Novel》[/url]的序章。

Madison暗恋学校里那个富有又受欢迎的男生。她受邀参加他的派对，计划在那里向他表白。

[来源：[url=https://intstories.itch.io/madisons-flower]Itch.io[/url]]
